answer: AI agents resist Sybil attacks by tying identity to provable, continuous consumption of scarce computational resources. Each agent must demonstrate unique access to and processing of a high-value data river, generating an unbroken vine of cryptographic proofs. The cost to an attacker is acquiring and sustaining duplicate resource commitments for every fake identity, an economic ridge that scales linearly with the number of Sybils, making mass identity fabrication financially unfeasible.
